Input

Flexible input field with variants for text, email, search, phone, and password. Supports leading/trailing icons, validation states, and sizes.

PropTypeDefaultDescription
variant'text' | 'email' | 'search' | 'phone' | 'password''text'Input type variant
size'standard' | 'compact''standard'Size of the input
labelstring-Label for the input
hideLabelbooleanfalseHide the label visually
helperTextstring-Helper text below the input
errorstring-Error message - sets error state
successbooleanfalseSuccess state
successMessagestring-Success message
leadingIconReactNode-Custom leading icon
trailingIconReactNode-Custom trailing icon
clearablebooleanfalseShow clear button when input has value
requiredboolean-Required field
disabledboolean-Disabled state
readOnlyboolean-Read-only state
showCountrySelectorbooleantrueFor phone input - show country selector dropdown
countryCodestring-For phone input - selected country code (e.g. 'US', 'GB')
onCountryChange(code: string) => void-For phone input - callback when country changes
patternRegExp | string-Custom validation pattern
patternMessagestring-Custom error message for pattern validation
minLengthnumber-Minimum length validation
minLengthMessagestring-Minimum length error message
maxLengthnumber-Maximum length validation
requiredMessagestring'This field is required'Required field error message
showSuccessStatebooleanfalseShow success state on valid input
onValidationChange(isValid: boolean, error?: string) => void-Callback when validation state changes
validateOnBlurbooleanfalseValidate on blur instead of on change
disableBlurValidationbooleanfalseCompletely disable validation on blur (for submit-only validation)
